goal: Process all ingress/egress data: recognize globally-linked HeadyRegistry values, propagate any change everywhere, keep data consistent

contracts.kind: canonical value + lock + link-sites for every registered key
recognize registered values in a payload + classify MATCH/DRIFT
blast-radius + change-set for a canonical change

capabilities.acceptance: every registered key → {canonical value, locked?, class, sot}
flatten a payload; mark each registered value MATCH or DRIFT vs canonical
DRIFT on a LOCKED value is BLOCKED fail-closed unless authorized
outgoing payload rewritten to canonical values — never emit a stale linked value
for a key, list every link-site across the repo (ripple)
authorized canonical change → change-set covering all link-sites
coherence gate green after propagation — 0 contradictions

acceptance.criterion: no inbound payload can set a locked value to a non-canonical value without authorization
no outbound payload emits a stale linked value
a canonical change reaches every link-site (no partial update)
the system is coherence-green after every applied change
